resolved_findings.resolution: Safe events are wired at API lifecycle/request and request-scoped Manager/memory creation boundaries with exactly one opaque per-request run_id, immutable 10A/r1/a1/core identity, measured finite latency and failing-sink isolation.

API, memory and explicitly authorized route call-sites no longer log or telemetry-export raw request/user/preference/Manager/memory/exception values; failure persistence uses stable codes and type-compatible redaction while the public API contract remains unchanged.
Core call-sites consume the observability-owned three-gate initializers with Settings credentials, isolate failure and remove raw exception capture.
The optional seed-selection event was not added; explicit seed-only and no-auto-seed behavior remain preserved and tested.

privacy_checks: No request query, raw user/session identity, preferences, Manager/Shared State, memory values, credentials, DSNs, exception text/stack, prompts, reasoning or raw evidence enters Stage-10A telemetry or registered logs.
Raw Sentry capture and unconditional route breadcrumbs were removed.
PRIVATE_SENTINEL tests cover logs, local event sinks, route persistence, Manager/memory creation and initializer/sink failure.
Existing persistence keys remain present; private payload fields receive deterministic opaque, redacted or empty type-compatible values.
User-visible response serialization remains compatible and is not replaced by the persistence redaction envelope.

contract_diff: Added only Stage-10A API/runtime configuration, safe exception, dependency/lifecycle, memory isolation, startup and privacy/observability call-site behavior.
The authorized analyze route change preserves request/response schema, Manager arguments, result mapping, row keys and progress/UI behavior while preventing raw private persistence/logging.
Preserved ManagerAgent constructor/run compatibility, canonical ForecastContext calculations and all accepted Stage-00 through Stage-09 product formulas.
Did not activate or implement Stage 10B business routes, versioned persistence, progress, backtest jobs, UI or E2E.
known_limitations: Stage 10B still owns versioned forecast persistence, authentication-aware user identity, route forecast fields, progress/backtest jobs, UI and E2E wiring.
Monthly memory persistence is intentionally deferred instead of merging into the legacy long_term_memory row.
The optional seed.command.selected telemetry event was not added.
Live providers, external databases and external trace exporters were intentionally not exercised.

rollback.source_and_tests: Restore the fifteen Core source/test paths to their pre-Stage10A workspace versions and retain all immutable workflow artifacts.
rollback.support_owned_files: Do not roll back langsmith_trace.py or core/observability.py from the Core artifact; retain their observability-owned hashes and artifacts.
rollback.downstream: Do not modify the accepted Stage09 handoff or activate Stage10B during rollback.
